instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief: BeamEcho Field Query Log controls the submission, routing, response, and closure of field questions raised from unclear drawing details. Trade Supervisors submit field questions and identify the affected work area. Site Engineers review questions, add site observations, and route them to Design Coordinators. Design Coordinators record responses and indicate whether affected work may proceed or remain paused. Document Controllers link final responses to related drawing records before field questions can be closed. The project covers those field-question activities but does not replace drawing revision control. The method for selecting the relevant Design Coordinator has not been defined.
